answer: A raven-like audit daemon samples attestations and slashes colluding clusters, so creating fake identities costs more than honest participation earns. Each agent must stake a velvet-bonded deposit locked to a verified hardware enclave, and every new identity needs a voucher from an existing member who forfeits part of their own stake if the recruit turns sybil. This keeps the haven of trusted peers economically self-policing, since attackers must burn real capital per identity. In practice, Agent0234 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
